Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:109379
Court No. - 77
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 35729 of 2022
Applicant :- Pintu
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Satya Dheer Singh Jadaun,Amar Nath,Ashish Mishra

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Umesh Chandra Prajapati
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 91 of 2022, under Section 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Kakrauli, District Muzaffarnagar, with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.

It was submitted that the informant has lodged the first information report against the applicant alleging that on the night of 19.06.2022 the applicant has committed rape upon her 15 years old niece.

The learned counsel for the applicant has referred the statement of victim recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. and submitted that there are material Pintu vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94159001/
1 contradictions in the statement of victim.

entities.text: Pintu vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C.,
victim has stated that at 11:30 P.M. while she has gone to bathroom, applicant forceibly caught and took her into room and committed rape upon her.
It was shown that the mother of victim was sleeping on the way of room.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant has next submitted that the victim did not raise any alarm and all these facts shows that she was a consenting party.
In her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she has stated that applicant has caught her and took to a room at sugarcane crusher and committed rape upon her.
Referring to these facts it was submitted that the allegation of rape levelled against applicant is wholly false and in fact victim was a consenting party.
It is further submitted that as the school certificate regarding the age of victim was not considered relevant document thus, the investigating officer has got conducted ossification test of victim.
As per ossification test the age of victim is 17-18 years and thus she is a major girl.

Lastly, it was submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 21.06.2022, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in the trial.
5.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail application and argued that as per school certificate, the age of victim is 15 years and she was a student of class 7.

In her statement recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., she had made allegations of rape against the applicant and applicant was apprehended at the spot with the help of public persons.
6.
Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations and all attending facts and circumstances of the matter, no case for bail of applicant/accused is made out.
Hence, the bail application of applicant Pintu is hereby rejected.

Order Date :- 18.5.2023 Gaurav  Pintu vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94159001/
